outcome: Apgar scores lower than 5 at 5 min
cohort: 173 cases of complete uterine rupture diagnosed in a large hospital system in Massachusetts between 2004 and 2018
finding: Unscarred uterine rupture and vaginal delivery were associated with an increased risk of adverse outcomes, such as hemorrhage, blood transfusion, hysterectomy, and perinatal death.
mod_finding: Uterine rupture during vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of transfusion and hysterectomy compared with emergent C-section.
